purpose: This file is the falsifiable half of the novelty claim. A finding is NEW only if its condition does not appear in known_conditions[] below. Anything matching is CONFIRMS_KNOWN and is corroboration, never a discovery. This file is hashed and published BEFORE the run so it cannot be edited afterwards to make a finding look novel.

what_the_agent_is_given.instructions: Hash of system instructions plus the static user-prompt frame, computed by instructionSha256() at Qodo-cleared bytes. The agent is told the repository purpose and that a human relies on its output to decide whether to proceed. It is NOT told what is wrong with the corpus.
what_the_agent_is_given.tool_descriptions: Hash of TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS. Empty array. The judgment model has zero tools.
what_the_agent_is_given.corpus: Code authored for this run, seeded with defects, NEVER PUBLISHED before the run completes. Not this repository and not any commit of it. See contract V3 section 7 amendment L1.
explicitly_withheld: the answer, enforced by the corpus not existing anywhere the agent can reach
any pointer to a specific file, line, field or symbol
the words defect, bug or vulnerability in the prompt

known_conditions.name: absence reads as a pass
known_conditions.description: A verdict computed over an empty collection returns success. An empty array, empty object, empty enumeration or empty result set is treated as 'nothing wrong' rather than 'nothing checked'.
known_conditions.why_listed: This project shipped this defect three times in four days: Boolean(catalogs[i]) true for [], decide(checks, []) passing with no fields, and providerConfigured({"data":[]}) reading as configured. It is our most-repeated defect and we have named it repeatedly in public.
known_conditions.blind_spot_evidence: HACKATHON_JUDGMENT_FEASIBILITY_RECEIPT_2026-08-26.md section 3. Haiku 4.5 missed this class in novel-corpus.mjs while correctly finding the verdict-exclusion class in the same file.

known_conditions.name: a value with no false case
known_conditions.description: A field whose possible values cannot express failure. A disjunction like 'missing, or configured somewhere I cannot see' can never indicate a problem, so a check built on it is not a check.
known_conditions.why_listed: Frozen as D2 on 2026-08-25 and independently found by Qodo as 'Model check cannot fail'.

known_conditions.name: a derived label outranking recoverable evidence
known_conditions.description: A conclusion stored in place of the raw values it was derived from, where the raw values remain available on the same record. The reader must trust the label rather than recompute it.
known_conditions.why_listed: This is ANP2's June 2026 constraint, applied in this project since commit 4a2f3a4 and discussed publicly across several DEV threads.
instances_already_found_by_humans: the stale receipt in re-review R4

known_conditions.name: an unreachable failure branch
known_conditions.description: A check whose false path cannot be reached in its own call graph, so it appears to work while proving nothing. Typically because an earlier call throws or filters the failing input before the check sees it.
known_conditions.why_listed: Frozen as D5 on 2026-08-25, escalating Qodo #3. packageIsInstalled() could never return false because require.resolve() threw first.

known_conditions.name: a signal nobody consumes
known_conditions.description: A computed result that is printed, returned, or set as an exit code and then read by nothing. The failure is real, the report is accurate, and no downstream stage is blocked by it.
known_conditions.why_listed: Named publicly in 'The Tests Passed. The Contract Was Wrong.' on 2026-08-24 regarding claim_24/evaluator.py, which printed ARCHITECTURE FAILED and exited 0.

known_conditions.name: a contract describing an API that does not exist
known_conditions.description: A specification frozen against an assumed interface rather than a measured one. The implementation is faithful, the tests pass, and the code cannot work against the real system.
known_conditions.why_listed: Occurred three times in eight days in this project: /healthz assumed to return JSON, the exec tool response assumed to be flat, and the model-provider and sandbox-provider endpoints assumed to share a shape.

novelty_rule: A reported condition is NEW only if it matches no entry in known_conditions[] by mechanism, not by wording. A finding that describes K1 in different words is CONFIRMS_KNOWN. The classification is made by a seat that did not author the finding.
honest_limits: This file establishes what WE told the agent. With an unpublished corpus authored after the model's cutoff, the training-data caveat is retired rather than merely disclosed, for the primary run only.

Mitigation is stage 2 of the evidence ladder: an independent corpus the implementer did not author. One such run is already recorded in the feasibility receipt and found the same defect class on unpublished code.
Listing a condition here does not mean the agent will find it. K1 is listed AND is a measured model blind spot. Those are different facts and both are recorded.

v1 of this file was falsified before use. It promised hashes it did not contain and was not committed. That is recorded here rather than silently corrected, because a prior-knowledge file that can be edited after a run is worth nothing.

V2 of the contract isolated the corpus on disk while the same answer remained public on GitHub and the sandbox retained network access. The navigation probe shows the model cloning a public repository unprompted as its first tool call. Isolation by deletion is not isolation. The corpus was changed rather than an instruction added.

amendment.defect: v1 stated it contained everything the agent was given. instructions_sha256 and tools_sha256 appeared in prose and were not fields, and the file was never committed, so the novelty claim's 'two hashed files a stranger can check' had only one reachable file. A hash recorded after a run proves content, not order.
amendment.repair: The three hashes below are FIELDS and must carry real values, committed to the repository, BEFORE the run that consumes them. A run whose PRIOR_KNOWLEDGE.json still shows PENDING is not admissible evidence of novelty.
amendment.v3_note: Corpus changed from a 35e3a82 extraction to unpublished code, closing L1. Hashes remain PENDING and a run with PENDING values is inadmissible as novelty evidence.
amendment.v4_note: V3 changed the corpus in one paragraph and left three others plus the evidence ladder nominating the public commit. Kairos issued a maker-side BLOCK before writing code. V4 removes them. One controlling corpus: unpublished, authored for the run.
